intro: Detroit's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $159/month, up 0.6% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Detroit metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $120, down 13.8% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $164. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $75 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$80.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $102 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$110. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $159, up 0.6% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Detroit metro non-climate asking rent $120, down 13.8% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Detroit alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$164.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $214 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$194.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $277 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$251.

local_tips: Detroit has about 14 facilities and 1.0 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 74,754 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026, a increase of 0.6% from the year before (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
